content: We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we don't have the structure. We need to get NMR spectra maybe to infer? Could also retrieve carbon shifts etc. But we need the molecule identity. No SMILES given. Perhaps the sample is implicit? Might need to request proton NMR to see methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input). It will return spectra string. Then we can count methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Let's try.
